# get_num_graphs { #mofography.data.get_num_graphs }

`data.get_num_graphs(db_path)`

The function `get_num_graphs` retrieves the number of graphs stored in a SQLite database specified
by the `db_path`.

## Parameters

| Name      | Type   | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          | Default    |
|-----------|--------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| `db_path` |        | The `db_path` parameter in the `get_num_graphs` function is the path to the SQLite database file that contains the table of graphs. This function connects to the SQLite database at the specified path, executes a SQL query to count the number of rows in the `graphs` table, and | _required_ |

## Returns

| Type   | Description                                                                                                                         |
|--------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | The function `get_num_graphs` returns the number of rows in the "graphs" table from the SQLite database specified by the `db_path`. |
